_note: Sideways-market range specialist (added 2026-11-16): buys the floor of a QUALIFIED horizontal range (both walls multi-touch fractal zones, flat ADX, range wide enough in ATR, mandatory reward:risk to the ceiling), exits at the ceiling / on range break / on time stop. Zone-native on trader/core/fractal_levels.py - does NOT follow the legacy/fractal sr_engine switch. Differs from sr_reversal: that fades any support after a momentum thrust (any structure, incl. downtrends); this trades only inside a proven range and needs no thrust or candlestick pattern. Tag SIDEWAYS via market_regime_tag (regime_match filter, globally disabled as of 2026-10-26 - enable it or sweep it to gate this strategy to sideways markets). exclude_filters rationale: trend_strength gates on ADX>=20, the exact inverse of this strategy's own ADX<=max_adx; quality (ATH/CUP) and market_efficiency reward trending tape; resistance blocks entries below a zone - this strategy's whole point is entering below the ceiling; room_to_resistance duplicates the built-in MANDATORY min_reward_risk gate; market_regime blocks entries when the market is not bullish - the exact regime this strategy exists for. Disabled by default - NOT backtested on real data yet: run isolated first (--strategy range_bounce), then tune_strategy.py --mode smart over the remaining filters (sector_regime, rs_rank, candlestick, sentiment, regime_match).
_wall_zones: 'major' (default) = range walls are the STRONGEST support/resistance zones (SMAJ/RMAJ). 'nearest' = original design, kept for sweeps - real-data funnel (360ONE, 590 sessions, 2026-11-16) showed nearest zones are ladder rungs ~1 ATR apart: the width gate passed on 3 of 324 candidate days and the strategy never fired.

entry._min_range_width_atr: range must pay: (ceiling.low - floor.high) >= this many ATRs of price. 2.0 ATR with the default 0.75-ATR zone tolerance keeps degenerate micro-ranges out.
entry._max_adx: flat-tape gate: daily ADX must be at or below this. trend_strength's own bar is >=20, so 22 leaves a small deliberate overlap zone.
entry._touch_proximity_pct: today's low must come within this % of the floor zone's top edge (or pierce it).
entry._require_bullish_close: close > open on the touch day - the rejection, not a knife-catch. No candlestick pattern required (unlike sr_reversal); the candlestick filter can still rank candidates.
entry._stop_anchor: 'touch_low' (default): stop = touch-day low - atr_mult x ATR (the rejection wick - standard range-trade stop; tighter, can be probed out while the range holds). 'zone_low': stop = floor zone low - buffer - structurally sound but unpayable: zones are ~1.2 ATR tall so risk ~ reward and min_reward_risk 1.5 was NEVER reached on real data (0 signals / 590 sessions, 360ONE funnel 2026-11-16).
entry._min_reward_risk: MANDATORY (not nullable like sr_reversal's): (ceiling.low - close) / (close - stop) must reach this. A range trade's target is known at entry by definition.

exit._target_tolerance_pct: exit when close is within this % below the ceiling zone's near edge.
exit._max_holding_days: calendar days; a range trade that reaches neither wall in this time is dead capital - exit and free the slot.
